Stop Three · Teddy's Garden

Meet Biscuit, the little teddy

Biscuit lives in this world full-time. His jobs: Head of Hugs, Chief Compliment Officer, and official keeper of messages from Aryan. He takes all three very seriously.

Biscuit says —Oh! Oh! You're here! I'm Biscuit. I have been practising my bow all morning. Was that a good bow? I fell over twice.
Stop Four · The Rainy-Day Room

For grey days and heavy hearts

Some days are rainy inside too. This room exists for those: a warm lamp, a soft blanket, rain on the window — and a hug that's always on standby.

the rain is just the sky watering your flowers, Patlo

The reading lamp. Tap it — some thoughts are easier under warm light. Aryan left it on for you, by the way.

The patchwork blanket is officially reserved for one person. The tiny plush on guard duty is named Button — Biscuit's cousin, equally devoted.

Books for rainy chapters: stories where everyone is kind and the ending behaves. Help yourself.

Feeling like the weather? This button was installed by Aryan himself and tested extensively.
